skills.name: Fire Bullet
skills.description: Shoots magic bullets. Bad effects on enemies.   *Negates enemies' regen (5 sec) *ATK x 3000% Area Damage

skills.name: Special Fireworks
skills.description: Launches fireworks. Good effects on allies.   *HP +400% (6 sec) *HP x 80% Area Recovery (per sec) (6 sec) *Reflects 120% of incoming skill damage as Physical/Magical damage (6 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Mushoku Tensei
abilities.description: Mushoku Tensei Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deployment Freeze
abilities.description: Gives a high chance that 1 Ranger on the opposite team will have the time until it can be redeployed frozen for a fixed amount of time when a Ranger with this Ability is deployed. Activates 10 seconds after the battle starts.
